notes: No product named "PDUMH20HVT" exists from Tripp Lite/Eaton. The closest real, verified model is the PDUMH20HV (3.2-3.8kW single-phase metered PDU, 200-240V, C20 inlet w/ L6-20P adapter, 8x C13 + 2x C19 outlets, 1U, 6.5in/16.5cm depth, ~6.8 lbs, LCD ammeter). A related ATS variant, PDUMH20HVAT, exists with dual C20 inputs and an internal transfer switch — flagging in case "HVT" was intended to reference that model instead. Manufacturer PDF datasheets (assets.tripplite.com) are image-based and could not be OCR'd directly; specs were corroborated across Eaton/Tripp Lite product pages, a ServeTheHome hands-on teardown review, and distributor listings (Anixter, ProVantage, DigiKey). No network/USB/dry-contact ports are present on this base metered (non-networked) model. Grade omitted on all ports per rules since none are SDI/HDMI/DP/USB-data/Ethernet.

ports.name: AC Input (C20)
ports.note: Female IEC-320 C20 inlet on PDU (mates with C19 plug on the supplied 12ft cord); PDU ships with an L6-20P-to-C19 adapter cord for direct L6-20P wall receptacle connection
